prompt.content: Who was appointed as the Earl of Hereford by William the Conqueror after the Norman invasion of England in 1066?

output: After the Norman invasion of England in 1066, William the Conqueror (also known as William the Bastard) appointed his half-brother Odo as the Earl of Hereford. Odo was the son of William’s father, Robert Curthose, and Matilda, daughter of the Holy Roman Emperor
